name: froemix
description: Froemix - Daisy Seed based Eurorack module, converted from the KiCad project in ../tmp

scripts.check:all: bun run check:netlist && bun run check:footprints && bun run check:parts
scripts.regen:check: python3 ../tools/kicad2tscircuit.py --out /tmp/froemix-regen-check && diff -r -x dist -x __snapshots__ -x node_modules -x .tscircuit -x package.json -x tsconfig.json -x bun.lock -x .gitignore -x .parts-cache.json -x checks /tmp/froemix-regen-check .
scripts.check:erc: export PATH="/Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS:$PATH"; kicad-cli sch erc --severity-exclusions -o /tmp/froemix-erc.rpt ../tmp/froemix.kicad_sch >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "unexcluded errors/warnings:"; grep -cE '^\s+; (error|warning)$' /tmp/froemix-erc.rpt || echo 0
